name: FlowBoard
tagline: Sketch storyboard frames, add prompts, link them with arrows, and get one continuous AI-generated video.
problem: Traditional animation means redrawing every frame and refining motion by hand.
solution: An infinite canvas of 16:9 frames; each sketch can be enhanced by AI and turned into a clip from a prompt, frames connected by arrows become a sequence, and clips merge into a single output of any length.
demo_moment: Team-described: draw two frames, connect them, and play the generated sequence.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Keeps context between connected clips so sequences stay coherent.
The canvas is the theme made literal.

lessons: Wrapping generative video in a storyboard metaphor gives users control they understand.
